setupDescription: Create the first account. It will be the administrator's, who creates the other users.
signInDescription: Sign in with the e-mail and password of your account.
changePasswordRequired: Your password is temporary: choose your own before going on.
changePasswordDescription: Other devices signed in to your account will be signed out.
usersDescription: Everyone with an account on this installation.
usersCreateDescription: They will choose their own password at their first sign-in.
usersCreated: {name} can now sign in with the temporary password.
errorTooManyAttempts: Too many failed attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
errorSignUpClosed: Sign-up is closed: ask the administrator for an account.
errorPasswordTooShort: The password needs at least 8 characters.
errorPasswordUnchanged: The new password must differ from the current one.
errorEmailTaken: An account already uses this e-mail.
errorSignInRequired: Your session has ended: sign in again.
errorAdminOnly: Only the administrator can do this.
consentOrigin: It comes from {client} and will be sent back to {back}.
consentUnknownOrigin: It will be sent back to {back}.
consentDescription: It will read your months, accounts and lines from an AI agent, as you. You can revoke it at any time in your settings.
consentWriteDescription: It asks to change your data too. Allow read only unless you want it to make changes for you.
mcpClientsDescription: The AI agents and apps you allowed to reach your data over MCP, at {endpoint}. Revoking one cuts it off at once.
mcpRevoked: {client} can no longer reach your data.
mcpDoorOpen: Every user can connect AI agents to their own data.
mcpDoorClosed: MCP access is turned off: no AI agent can reach this installation.
mcpDoorUnavailable: MCP access needs Gousset to be served over HTTPS, or on this machine (localhost). Serve it over HTTPS to turn it on.
notFoundDescription: The address may be mistyped, or the page has moved.
reviewMadeUp: Made-up data: every account, line and amount here is invented.
reviewNothingToReview: Nothing left to review this month.
reviewApproveFailed: The line could not be approved; it is back in the list.
reviewAlreadyReviewed: This line was already reviewed elsewhere.
operationsEmptyDescription: Every expense, income and transfer of the month will be listed here, with its category, its subjects and how it was paid.
accountsEmptyDescription: Your bank accounts, savings, benefit cards and investment accounts will show here with their balance, from their first imported statement.
investmentsEmptyDescription: Your investment accounts and what they hold will show here: their value, what you put in and what it earned.
subjectsEmptyDescription: A subject gathers the expenses of one thing across categories: a house, a van, a trip. Yours will be listed here.
importEmptyDescription: The bank statements you import will be listed here, with what each one added and what is left to check.
settingsLanguageDescription: The language of the interface on this device. It follows your browser until you choose one.
settingsColorSchemeDescription: Follow the system, or keep the interface light or dark.
categoriesEmptyDescription: Your categories, on two levels, will be listed here with their 6-month average and their benchmark.
uiErrorTitle: This block could not be loaded
uiErrorMessage: Something went wrong on the way. The rest of the page still works.
uiChartEmpty: Nothing spent yet in this period.
reviewMadeUp: Made-up data: every account, line and amount here is invented.
reviewSubjectsEmpty: No expense of the month is attached to a subject.
reviewSpendingPending: {amount} more waits in the lines to review.
reviewSpendingAllReviewed: Every line of the month is reviewed.
reviewFlagsEmpty: Nothing to point out this month.
reviewApproveFailed: The line could not be approved; it is back in the list.
reviewAlreadyReviewed: This line was already reviewed elsewhere.
rulesEmptyDescription: Rules classify your lines on import: if the label contains this, then this merchant and category. Most are born from a correction during the review.
